findings.text: follow-on: the landed 2,000-cell diverted test is marked xfail(strict=True) because the row does not converge (head residual 2.2567326434608685e-2, converged=false), so the node's done-when clause (2) -- 'the diverted 2,000-cell row reaches 1e-12 ... and pass at head' -- is unmet and only the mark keeps the suite green; the goal this node was dispatched for is not achieved.

follow-on: the two remaining candidates are cited with wrong call sites; _local_axis_sector (def at kernel.py:51) is said to be 'called at kernel.py:213' but its call sites are kernel.py:97, 184 and 356, and _flux_past_level_weight (def at kernel.py:123) is said to be 'called at kernel.py:209 and kernel.py:210' but is called at kernel.py:180 and 181 -- lines 209-213 are the near-weight and sector-weight computation, so the pointer misdirects the next probe.

follow-on: the claimed negative control does not control the landed change -- the net diff carries no kernel.py change (kernel.py is byte-identical to base 1c97e17be), so overwriting kernel.py with the base in H200 job 1290655 is a no-op against the head and the control (residual 0.022567326444942717) shows only that the test is red at both revisions, not that it discriminates them.

follow-on: the new test duplicates the body of its sibling test_certified_diverted_carrier_converges (tests/equilibrium/test_certificate_550_convergence.py:105) -- same subprocess invocation, same receipt reads and same slope assertion, differing only in --cells 2000 -- rather than sharing a helper, though a separate committed test was the brief's own request.

item_verdicts.call_sites: none -- the landed change is a test file and two documents; no production module imports or is reached by it (grep over the tree for test_certificate_550_convergence finds no production caller), and the kernel.py edit it once carried is reverted so kernel.py is identical to base.
item_verdicts.diff: read the twelve commits 483aece78..50dd15886 against base 1c97e17be; the net diff is 3 files (+73/-1) -- tests/equilibrium/test_certificate_550_convergence.py +59, docs/evidence/fragments/converged-forward-solve/certificate-diverted-2000.html +13 (new), docs/research/certificate-550-convergence.html +1/-1 -- and the kernel.py edit at 483aece78 is reverted at 12ce33bc5, so the landed tree carries no runtime change.
item_verdicts.done_when: read the brief's three clauses; (3) is delivered -- the two stale figures are corrected and each cited to its job (job 1290518), the paired suite ran base 1c97e17be 27 passed 2 skipped against head 2d31cc004 27 passed 3 skipped, and a sacct wait_probe is declared -- but (1) is unmet (the named saddle-cell membership was refuted, not the jumping decision) and (2) is unmet (the diverted 2,000-cell row stalls at 2.2567326434608685e-2 and the test is xfailed rather than passing at head).
item_verdicts.goal: the goal "Make the certified diverted 2,000-cell carrier's forward solve converge" (brief.txt:1) is not met: the row still stalls at 2.2567326434608685e-2 after twelve corrections, converged=false, so the only carrier the goal names does not converge.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, commits 483aece78..50dd15886 listed, both suite arms recorded completed with zero failures, the refutation and the remaining candidates set out, and the diverted 2,000-cell stall carried honestly as a follow-on rather than claimed converged.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's declared write paths; every path in the net diff is inside them -- the test file, the evidence fragment and the research document -- and the reverted kernel.py is also inside.

justifications.durability: the only landed runtime artefact is the strict xfail at tests/equilibrium/test_certificate_550_convergence.py:155, which reddens when the row converges but guards nothing about the landed change; there is no code to regress (kernel.py is identical to base) and the added 900 s timeout mark at :52 is not asserted by any test.
justifications.evidence: the done-when's measure is the committed test run on the H200 (h200_gate2.log: 2 passed 1 xfailed in 2221.86 s, EXIT=0) and the four-row residual receipt (h200_rows_gate.log, H200 1290652), but the asserted 1e-12 is not reached, the after arm ran at 2d31cc004 rather than the reviewed head 50dd15886, and the control at h200_control_gate.log reverts a kernel change the landed tree does not carry.
justifications.fit: the new test mirrors its sibling tests/equilibrium/test_certificate_550_convergence.py:104 in import style, marks and assertion shape and introduces no forbidden name, but the evidence fragment misdirects a reader to kernel.py:209-213 for calls that sit at kernel.py:180-184 and 356.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the goal names one carrier, the certified diverted 2,000-cell row, and it does not converge at head; docs/evidence/fragments/converged-forward-solve/certificate-diverted-2000.html:10 records converged=false at 2.2567326434608685e-2, so the landed change records the failure rather than delivering the convergence.
justifications.reuse: the addition forks no production capability -- it reuses scripts/prototypes/fast_map_production/solver.py and the read path -- but its body is a near-exact copy of the sibling at tests/equilibrium/test_certificate_550_convergence.py:105 rather than extending it, and the brief itself asked for a separate committed test.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat 1c97e17be 50dd15886 lists only tests/equilibrium/test_certificate_550_convergence.py, docs/evidence/fragments/converged-forward-solve/certificate-diverted-2000.html and docs/research/certificate-550-convergence.html, all inside the declared write paths, with kernel.py net-unchanged.
